Q: Google Maps setCenter() A:

@phoenix24 answer actually helped me (whose own answer did not solve my problem btw). The correct arguments for setCenter is

map.setCenter({lat:LAT_VALUE, lng:LONG_VALUE});

[Google Documentation][1]

By the way if your variable are lat and lng the following code will work

map.setCenter({lat:lat, lng:lng});

This actually solved my very intricate problem so I thought I will post it here. [1]: https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/javascript/reference#LatLngLiteral

Q: Rexexp fails when in Bash script A:

It seems problem makes " " in bash.

It seems it treats first " as end of (^[0-9]+) and second " as beginning of longer string.

I found 2 methods:

  1. use \ to escape spaces instead of " "
x='866275 2016-02-06 11:25 Documents/familystuff/Household/Agri Stuff/Sheep/sheep Photos/2014 ewe lambs/074Cleo 6Feb16a.jpg'

if [[ $x =~ (^[0-9]+)\ [0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}\ [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}\ (.+) ]]; then 
 echo bash0 Captured : ${BASH_REMATCH[0]}
 echo bash1 Captured number: ${BASH_REMATCH[1]}
 echo bash2 Captured NAME: ${BASH_REMATCH[2]}
fi
  1. put all in ( ) and use normal spaces instead of " "
    but it needs to change indexes in BASH_REMATCH
x='866275 2016-02-06 11:25 Documents/familystuff/Household/Agri Stuff/Sheep/sheep Photos/2014 ewe lambs/074Cleo 6Feb16a.jpg'

if [[ $x =~ ((^[0-9]+) [0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2} (.+)) ]]; then 
 echo bash0 Captured : ${BASH_REMATCH[0]}
 echo bash1 Captured number: ${BASH_REMATCH[2]}
 echo bash2 Captured NAME: ${BASH_REMATCH[3]}
fi

Result:

bash0 Captured : 866275 2016-02-06 11:25 Documents/familystuff/Household/Agri Stuff/Sheep/sheep Photos/2014 ewe lambs/074Cleo 6Feb16a.jpg
bash1 Captured number: 866275
bash2 Captured NAME: Documents/familystuff/Household/Agri Stuff/Sheep/sheep Photos/2014 ewe lambs/074Cleo 6Feb16a.jpg

Tested on: GNU bash 5.2.21, Linux Mint 22 (based on Ubuntu 24.04)

Full code used for tests:

#!/bin/bash 

x='866275 2016-02-06 11:25 Documents/familystuff/Household/Agri Stuff/Sheep/sheep Photos/2014 ewe lambs/074Cleo 6Feb16a.jpg'

echo '--- 1 ---'

if [[ $x =~ ((^[0-9]+) [0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2} (.+)) ]]; then 
 echo bash0 Captured : ${BASH_REMATCH[0]}
 echo bash1 Captured : ${BASH_REMATCH[1]}
 echo bash2 Captured number: ${BASH_REMATCH[2]}
 echo bash3 Captured NAME: ${BASH_REMATCH[3]}
fi

echo '--- 2 ---'

if [[ $x =~ (^[0-9]+)\ [0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}\ [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}\ (.+) ]]; then 
 echo bash0 Captured : ${BASH_REMATCH[0]}
 echo bash1 Captured number: ${BASH_REMATCH[1]}
 echo bash2 Captured NAME: ${BASH_REMATCH[2]}
fi
